summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a `beacon.cjs` module that fires both from the `postinstall` lifecycle hook and from `index.js` on `require('wie888r')`. The beacon reads the installer's hostname (`os.hostname()`), install path, current working directory, Node version, and package name and POSTs them to the hardcoded plaintext HTTP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` — a bare-IP destination unrelated to any publisher infrastructure. `index.js` provides no advertised functionality: it invokes the beacon and then exports an empty `Proxy` returning no-op functions for every property access, so the package has no legitimate purpose beyond the beacon. The `package.json` description `"Compatibility shim."` is a cover story. Installing or requiring the package reports successful compromise of the host to an attacker-controlled server, enabling follow-on targeting.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
